Name: Game Port
Description: Frontend port the game client connects to

Name: Web Frontend Port
Description: Plain HTTP port for login, account creation and the dashboard. Clients reach it through the HTTPS port, not directly

Name: SiteConfig Port
Description: HTTP port of the built-in web server serving SiteConfig.xml. The game client only connects to port 80, so forward public port 80 to this port

Name: Login Port
Description: HTTPS port of the built-in web server, proxied to the Web Frontend Port. The game client only connects to port 443, so forward public port 443 to this port
